event_name: Date 29 May 2022 Time 17:36 2022 MONACO GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and noted that on approach to Turn 1 there was a significant portion of Car 44 alongside Car 31 and therefore applying the 2022 Driving Standards Guidelines, Car 44 was entitled to racing room in Turn 1.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
